title: Avocado Night Cream for Men: A Simple 60-Second Routine
ex: Shaving, sun and soap leave men's skin feeling tight. Here is how to use an avocado night cream in under a minute, with tips for beards and oily skin.
rt: Avocado Night Cream for Men: Simple Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Avocado night cream for men: a 60-second night routine, how to use it with shaving or a beard, how much for oily skin, and why morning sunscreen matters.
quick: Yes, men can use avocado night cream. After washing your face at night, press a pea-sized amount over damp skin, or half that if your skin is oily. Keep it off fresh shaving cuts, and use sunscreen every morning, especially with kojic acid.
facts: A pea-sized amount is enough; oily skin needs about half.
Shave in the morning and apply the cream at night.
Do not apply kojic acid cream on nicks or razor burn.
